backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profile management, shop openings, products, testimonials, and baking tips with access control using MixinAuthorization and role-based permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of the login/logout button from the Header component at a specific XPath location.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and configuration for a luxury bakery website with authentication and admin features.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, defining the luxury bakery color palette including cream, chocolate, gold, and blush tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Crème Patisserie application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component setting up React Router with home and admin routes, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and shared Layout with Header, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationSecti: Section component displaying four celebration occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, gifts, corporate) with emoji icons over a background image.
frontend/src/components/CustomerQuerySec: Empty placeholder file for removed customer query functionality.
Final call-to-action section with background image, headline, and Order Now button that scrolls to the location section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking, and heart icon in gold.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header with logo, admin button for authenticated admins, Order Now CTA, scroll effects, and backdrop blur (login/logout button removed).
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with cafe background image, headline, subtext, badge, and two CTA buttons for ordering and visiting.
Displays business location information including address, hours, phone, and Instagram with icons, plus buttons for directions and calling.
frontend/src/components/MenuHighlightsSe: Shows a grid of menu items (cupcakes, brownies, Korean bun, cakes) with images and descriptions, plus buttons to view/download the full menu in a dialog.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Displays a 4.9-star rating with customer testimonials in styled cards, highlighting positive reviews from Sanskriti Mishra and Ajit Singh.
frontend/src/components/WhySection.tsx: Presents the bakery's value proposition with a heading, description, and four feature badges (premium ingredients, presentation, gifting, local love).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, with query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Provides authentication hooks (useIsAdmin, useGetCallerUserRole) that query the backend actor for user permissions and roles.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider with login/logout functionality, identity persistence, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file kept for import compatibility; previously contained customer query functionality that has been removed.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles with Tailwind, custom OKLCH color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), font imports (Playfair Display, Inter), and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks user authentication and admin status, displaying access denied for non-admins or a placeholder admin panel for authorized users.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component that composes and renders seven section components: Hero, Why, Testimonials, MenuHighlights, Celebration, Location, and FinalCTA.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), semantic color tokens using OKLCH, custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), and extended design tokens for borders, shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking one existing feature to remove the login/logout button from the Header component, with no new feature requests or known issues.
